name: agent-eating-hotpot
description: 武汉吃火锅（癞子山庄）网页对战

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hotpot/engine && npm run build -w @hotpot/web && npm run build -w @hotpot/server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hotpot/engine && concurrently -n engine,server,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run build:watch -w @hotpot/engine" "npm run dev -w @hotpot/server" "npm run dev -w @hotpot/web"
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @hotpot/engine && npm run build -w @hotpot/web
